name: gizza-ai/utm-link-builder
summary: Append UTM campaign parameters to a URL

tool.description: Build a campaign-tracking URL by appending UTM query parameters (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign required; optional utm_term, utm_content, and the GA4 fields utm_id, utm_source_platform, utm_creative_format, utm_marketing_tactic). Values are URL-encoded; existing query params and fragment are preserved and old utm_* tags replaced. Runs locally.
